title: Fake Utility Shutoff
scenario: A caller says electricity will be cut today unless payment is made by voucher.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.C: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Fake Utility Shutoff: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Utilities do not demand vouchers through threatening calls.
